content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Or carbon NMR to see methyl carbons. Use minimal experiments. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count methyl peaks (triplet etc). But we need to know number of CH3 groups, not necessarily distinct signals (could be overlapping). Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (signals around 10-30 ppm). Let's request proton NMR first.
